intensity.label: Intensity
intensity.help: How strong the coffee feels overall: light and mild (1) or powerful and bold (5).

bitterness.label: Bitterness
bitterness.help: The bitter taste, like dark chocolate or grapefruit. Some bitterness is normal; a lot can mean a very dark roast.

acidity.label: Acidity
acidity.help: The bright, mouth-watering quality, like citrus or green apple. Not a flaw: it makes coffee taste fresh.

body.label: Body
body.help: How heavy the coffee feels in your mouth: thin like water (1) or thick and round like whole milk (5).

notes.label: Flavour notes
notes.help: Flavours you recognise. Tick whatever comes to mind; there are no wrong answers.

again.label: Would you drink it again?
again.help: If this coffee were in the machine tomorrow, would you be happy?
